New indices auto-apply via ism_template. Single-node cluster shows yellow due to unassigned replica on .opendistro-ism-config (expected, not a problem).

WordPress plugin removal remediation runbook created for ai-webchat-3cx. Standard pattern: wp plugin delete → manual rm -rf → chown/chmod fix → option/transient cleanup → cache flush → verification. Stuck plugin removal almost always caused by ownership mismatch between web server UID and files installed by different user.
